title: The Resurrection of the Four Spirits
text: “Liberation Prominence X!”

As if to deliver the finishing blow, I created a pseudo-sun and directed it at the center of the Dragon King, incinerating it. But—the number “10” on the hourglass remained completely unchanged. The Dragon King reformed, as if it had fled into a nearby raincloud.

Could it be that all these rain clouds are actually the Dragon King? If so, there’s no end to this. Just as I was thinking that, the rain clouds turned into a tornado and launched an attack that swept through the area.
“Motoyasu-kun!”
“Oh? Father, what’s the matter?”
“Thanks to you buying us time, we’ve managed to get most of the people in Melromarc evacuated—did you notice?”
“What do you mean?”
“There’s only one Dragon King here. It seems others have appeared and are starting to scatter across the country!”
“What!?”
Is this one of those that needs to be defeated all at once, too? If so, the penalty might be proliferation, just like with the Phoenix. I really wish they’d cut it out already.

“They’re moving across the country, dropping torrents of strong acid rain from scattered rain clouds. And whenever Motoyasu-kun delivers the finishing blow, they turn into tornadoes and destroy towns all over the place.”
“So, does that mean we have to gather all the scattered rain clouds in one place before we can take them down?”
“Probably… yeah. If those tornadoes are part of the penalty too…”

It’s like trying to catch a cloud. Bringing together the fragments of the Dragon King scattered throughout Melromarc… it seems to possess properties that are almost as if it were a direct replica of the Dragon Emperor himself.
“However, we’re lucky that the range within which it can scatter seems to be limited. At least, that’s what the survivors say.”
“So we’ve managed to inflict a fatal wound, then?”

“Yeah. But we have to gather them in one place first… and make sure they don’t scatter again before we finish it off. As expected of the Last of the Four Spirits… its strength is on a whole different level compared to the Spirit Tortoise or the Phoenix.”
“And it’s connected to the other Four Spirits, isn’t it?”
“Probably.”
Well, on top of all these conditions, we have to defeat the Dragon King in the end. Isn’t that beyond what I can handle with my abilities alone?
“So, about that, Motoyasu-kun…”
“What is it?”
My father points toward the wreckage of the airship.
“The Seven Star Weapons we took from Takt are still drifting over there, and they look like they’re about to burst out at any moment…”
“Whoa!”
Those are the ones I’ve been holding back because my father told me to limit myself to seizing them for negotiation purposes.
“Then we’ll have to retreat temporarily and issue orders to the weapons.”
“You’re right. Since the evacuation is more or less complete, we should pull back here and regroup.”
“Understood! Yuki-chan, we’re retreating!”
“Roger that!”

We unleashed Brionac on the attacking Dragon King and made a temporary retreat. The Dragon King, recognizing us as a threat, didn’t pursue us further; as soon as we retreated, it began moving—presumably to hunt down its prey.

That said, it’s still within sight… but that’s to be expected on the Melromarc Plains. The remaining airships retreated immediately on the Queen’s orders and were unharmed, but the one Takt was aboard has been reduced to a pitiful wreck. Amid the wreckage, the Seven Star Weapons Takt had been carrying were drifting, emitting a faint glow.
I’d been keeping them floating for negotiation purposes, but this is a detour… I hope it works out. My father is holding up his shield and commanding the weapon. I’ll do the same.
“Vassal Weapons. In response to this dire situation, take residence within a new master and become a source of power!”
“If possible, I’d like you to take residence within one of our comrades—”
As I said this to the Seven Star Weapons, they glowed, soared high into the sky, and flew away. Then, they turned into a beam of light and flew back toward us.
“Eek!”
“Whoa!”
When I turned around, a whip and claws had materialized in the hands of my assistant and the Panda Beastman, respectively.
“W-why me?”
My assistant was flustered, showing the weapons in her hands to her Rival and Keel.
“Isn’t it because Wyndia-chan has good chemistry with monsters?”
“B-but…”
“Big Sis became a Hero!”
“‘Big Sis! You did it! You’ve really made it big now!’”

The panda beastman’s subordinates—who’d been there all along but had been completely invisible until now—are showering her with praise. I wonder if they couldn’t find candidates for the other two? It’s a bit of a worrying situation to figure out.
“Still, you know… isn’t it a bit unreasonable to expect her to fight a monster like that?”
The panda beastman stares at the claws attached to his hands, then looks at the Dragon King and says.
“If she uses the proper enhancement methods, she should be able to get stronger—though not quite as strong as us.”
“She just hasn’t caught up to the situation yet… Seriously, what’s up with a mere mercenary suddenly becoming a hero?”
“She’s so cute that I’ve drifted away from her.”
“Quiet!”
The Panda Beastman is being scolded by her Father. And Yuki-chan had a throwing weapon clenched in her hand.
“Oh! So Yuki-chan has been chosen, then.”
“I don’t really know how to use it, but I suppose I have no choice but to give it a try.”
“Is it because Yuki-chan sometimes used Magic to throw her wings?”
“Oh? Is it for throwing? Well, then I understand the basics.”

Come to think of it, Midori was once chosen as the Axe Hero. Even Filolial-sama could do it if she had the aptitude. Yuki-chan is a surprisingly versatile girl who can do just about anything. That’s probably why she was selected for the Projectile Hero role—to provide rear support. But… a hammer, though…
“Sa—Sakura-chan?”
Her finacée calls out to Sakura-chan with a look of surprise.
“Hmm?”
A hammer had materialized in Sakura-chan’s hand.
“Whoa! That’s awesome! So Sakura-chan’s a Hero too—I wanted to be one too.”
“Given the type of weapon, it might be tough for Keel-kun.”
“What about a throwing weapon?”
“Don’t you need to be pretty dexterous? It looked like she was having a hard time deciding between Yuki-chan and Keel-kun for her Vassal Weapons, too.”
“I see… That’s too bad!”
At Father’s words, Keel slumped his shoulders in disappointment.
“Sakura-chan has a tendency to just charge in and slash at her opponents with brute force, so maybe she’ll be able to handle it somehow.”
“Do I just hold it and swing it?”
“For now, anyway. We’ll practice when we have time. First, everyone, let’s learn how to strengthen ourselves… because the battles ahead are going to get tougher.”

I suppose that’s what they call a silver lining. Perhaps the spirit of the Seven Star Weapons understood how dire the situation is and chose a user—even if only temporarily. Either way, our combat strength has increased.
“Booh…”
“Elena, there’s no way I didn’t notice you breathing a sigh of relief. For now, please protect Melty-chan in Sakura-chan’s place.”
That Lazy Pig hasn’t changed a bit. Just as I was thinking that…
BAM!
My heart and my Father’s heart both leapt out of our chests. “Gigi…” My Father turned toward me. The others who’d been chosen by the Seven Star Weapons also tilted their heads at the sound.
“Hey, Motoyasu-kun, I really don’t want to confirm this, but… doesn’t this prove what we were just talking about—the overload on the seals?”
“Exactly. I never imagined the seals would break one after another like a domino effect.”
In my field of vision… the number 9 had appeared on the hourglass.
“For now, let’s hurry over to the airship where the Queen of Melromarc ordered everyone to evacuate. It seems they’re going to use that as our command center.”
“Understood. Yuki-chan! Filolial-sama and the others! Let’s head over there.”
And so, we rushed toward the airship, which was serving as our command center.
Various pieces of equipment brought from Melromarc had been delivered to the command center. The Queen, acting as the representative, was marking the extent of the damage on a map.

“Lord Iwatani, Lord Kitamura, thank you for coming. Regarding the matter of Takt, we’ve already notified Faubrey. However, since the seal on the Qilin has been broken, Faubrey has just ordered the dispatch of a Hero.”
“What is the extent of the damage to the country!?”
“Melromarc Castle and the town below it have been completely devastated, but thanks to the Hero, the number of casualties has been kept to a minimum.”
“I see… By the way, now that all four spirits have been revived, can’t we summon the Seven-Star Heroes? For example, this country’s Seven-Star Heroes?”
In response to Father’s words, the Queen closed her eyes tightly before replying.

“I’m sorry. Aultcray, the Seven-Star Hero of the Staff, has been disowned by the Staff due to having spent too long in peace. We will dispatch him, but it may be difficult to count him as a combat asset.”
“Trusting him could open up a way to strengthen him… but I suppose that’s not going to happen.”
“As with Takt, I recommend stripping him of his title and recruiting a new holder for the sake of the world.”
The Queen answered as if making a painful decision. Well, it would have been strange if it hadn’t come to that.
